title: CIA® Certification (Certified Internal Auditor)
body: The Institute of Internal Auditors (The IIA)
source: The IIA 2025 Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS) Framework
summary: The premier global internal audit designation realigned to the 2025 Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS) across Part 1 Fundamentals, Part 2 Engagement, and Part 3 Business Knowledge (Acumen, InfoSec, IT, Financial Management).

standard.name: Standard 3-Part GIAS Pathway
standard.blurb: Pass all three examination parts under the 2025 GIAS standards and document 1 to 2 years of verified internal audit experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: Eligibility & Registration
stages.subtitle: CCMS portal registration, degree verification, and character reference

nodes.name: Candidate Application & Degree Verification
nodes.description: Create an account on the IIA CCMS portal, submit university transcripts verifying an accredited degree, and pay the program application fee.
resources: The IIA's CIA Learning System (Parts 1, 2, and 3), The Institute of Internal Auditors
Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS 2025), IIA Standards Board
Gleim CIA Review System (Parts 1, 2, and 3), Dr. Irvin N. Gleim, Gleim Publications
Sawyer's Internal Auditing: Enhancing and Protecting Organizational Value (7th Ed.), IIA Foundation
learningOutcomes: Interpret and apply the 2025 Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS) across internal audit engagements
Plan, execute, and communicate assurance and consulting engagement findings to executive leadership
Evaluate governance, business acumen, information security, and financial management controls

nodes.name: Character Reference Verification
nodes.description: Submit an official character reference signed by an active CIA, supervisory manager, or recognized professional certifying moral and ethical integrity.
